disposition.adjacent_merging: Measured useful candidate in a complete native headless comparison

limits: Percentiles are measured 128 microsecond histogram intervals, not exact point estimates.
pread wall intervals include the OS path and overlap; they are not SSD NAND or hardware queue service times.
The two-lane occupancy describes application calls, not underlying block/NVMe queue depth or maximum device parallelism.
Cache concentration describes the fixed counting workload; it does not establish the distribution of arbitrary prompts.
Native comparison rates exclude prefill and EOS and must not be pooled with normal prefix/speculative requests.
The 0.48996 percent gain is a small ABBA result with two timed repetitions per mode, not a statistically established general speedup.
